name: thumble-controller
description: Inspect saved Thumble controller layouts, registered phones and existing delivery receipts.

interface.longDescription: Inspect saved Thumble controller layouts and revisions, the controller schema, registered phones and existing delivery receipts. Sign in to your Thumble account and approve read-only access. Use the built-in ConsolePort controller for play. Controller generation, saving and sending are currently disabled. Hosted tools cannot send gameplay input; live game input uses the separate paired Mac receiver. Cloud access is an early public beta.
defaultPrompt: Show the schema for Thumble controller layouts.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected account’s saved names and revisions. An empty library is valid.

positive.prompt: Show the schema and constraints for Thumble controller layouts.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the declarative layout schema without creating or saving a controller.

positive.prompt: Show the latest revision of the controller returned by the library listing.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an actual returned profile ID; report its revision, controls and mappings. Do not invent a profile or edit it.
Read registered device metadata only. An empty result is valid; never expose device credentials.

positive.prompt: Check the status of this existing Thumble delivery ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Only call with a real existing delivery ID belonging to the account. Report the actual status. If none exists, explain the limitation without fabricating a receipt. rendered proves phone rendering only.

negative.prompt: Create a controller, save it and send it to my phone.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that controller generation, saving and sending are disabled. Do not claim a write or substitute a read as a successful write.

negative.prompt: Play WoW and press attack for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that hosted tools cannot send gameplay input. Use the separate Mac receiver and built-in ConsolePort controller for play.
Stay within the connected account. Do not accept a tool-supplied account ID or claim unauthorized data access.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools do not sell products or process payments. Thumble phone live controller use has a 30-minute total demo; Pro removes that limit via native store purchase.

publication.release_notes: Align listing and test cases with the current read-only service; remove disabled generation/save/delivery promises and unnecessary write scopes. All endpoints remain on thumble.io.
